collectionMethod: Manual capture of the official OpenCode Go documentation page (https://opencode.ai/docs/go/, which 301-redirects to /docs/console/go/), the Go landing page (https://opencode.ai/go, 302-redirects to /console/go), the OpenCode console changelog RSS feed (https://opencode.ai/console/changelog/rss.xml) and the full model catalog endpoint referenced by the documentation (https://opencode.ai/inference/go/v1/models), around 10:39 Beijing time / 02:39Z on 2026-11-17 (server Date headers 02:39:05Z and 02:39:06Z). The three documentation captures (docs, console-docs and v2-docs) are byte-identical to each other at 101791 bytes. All four surfaces were compared against the 2026-11-16 captures of the same URLs and against the already-archived data/research/opencode-go-qwen4-max-round1-2026-11-16.json: the documentation HTML changed (the Qwen4 Max and Hy4 flash Free rows are new relative to the 101791 → 99845 byte 2026-11-16 capture), the landing page changed (new template, 'View all 32 models', Hy4 banner removed), the RSS XML is byte-identical to the 2026-11-16 capture, and the models API grew from 31 to 32 catalog entries. Every price, limit and estimate below is transcribed as published; the documentation tables, the landing-page table and the models API were read independently and are kept side by side wherever they disagree. Research-only — no adopted row generated, no adopted value changed, no script changed, no chart or site change.
scope: OpenCode Go official models interface only. The change on 2026-11-17 is that the official documentation and the Go landing page now publish a full Qwen4 Max allowance row — three-part price, Monthly limit, per-window estimated requests, request shape, privacy and endpoint — where the 2026-11-16 documentation had no such row at all, while the models API entry for the already-published 'qwen4-max' model had its output limit lowered and gained a Go allowance block. The new free model 'Hy4 flash Free' also appeared on the same day. Research-only — not adopted; no adopted.csv row, no computed allowance, no script change, no leaderboard/score data.
adoptionStatus: research-only; not adopted; no opencode_go × qwen4-max row in adopted.csv yet — adding one requires an OPENCODE_GO_MODELS entry in scripts/build_adopted.py, left to maintainer review

paidModel.name: Qwen4 Max

paidModel.description: Flagship multimodal model for coding, office productivity, frontend design, and complex agentic tasks
paidModel.statusChange: New paid row added to all three official OpenCode Go documentation price tables (Go / Go Plus / Go Teams) on 2026-11-17, to the three 'Estimated requests' tables, to the request-shape list, to the Endpoints table and to the Privacy table, and to the Go landing-page model table with a 'New' marker. On 2026-11-16 the same documentation had no Qwen4 Max row anywhere.

endpoint.note: The documentation Endpoints table publishes the full messages path; the models API entry publishes the API family base_url together with an api.messages block. Both are recorded as published.

outputLimitChange.note: The models API entry for qwen4-max carried limit.output = 393216 on 2026-11-16 and carries limit.output = 262144 on 2026-11-17. limit.context is 1000000 on both days. The documentation does not publish an output limit, so this change is visible only in the interface.

threePartPrice.cacheWriteNote: The documentation price table publishes a single Cached Write value of $1.875, while the models API publishes cache write as two tiers: 5m = 1.875 and 1h = 3. Both are recorded as published; neither is flattened into the other.
threePartPrice.priceScope: The Go, Go Plus and Go Teams documentation price tables all show the same three-part price for Qwen4 Max; no plan-specific price row exists.
threePartPrice.sourceQuote: Docs Go table: 'Qwen4 Max | $1.50 | $4.50 | $0.075 | $1.875 | $15'; Docs Go Plus table: 'Qwen4 Max | $1.50 | $4.50 | $0.075 | $1.875 | $60'; Docs Go Teams table: 'Qwen4 Max | $1.50 | $4.50 | $0.075 | $1.875 | $20'; models API cost.text: input.price = 1.5, input.cache.read = 0.075, input.cache.write = {5m: 1.875, 1h: 3}, output.price = 4.5

paidModel.monthlyLimitNote: Published identically on two independent surfaces on 2026-11-17: the documentation Monthly limit column (Go $15, Go Plus $60, Go Teams $20) and the models API go.monthly_usage block ({go: 15, go-plus: 60, go-teams: 20}). The qwen4-max entry carried no go block at all on 2026-11-16, so this allowance is new in the interface as well as in the documentation.

officialRequestEstimates.note: Official 'Estimated requests' figures from the three documentation tables (table header: Model | Requests per 5 hours | Requests per week | Requests per month). Kept as published cross-check evidence only.
officialRequestEstimates.usageWindowRule: Each model has the following usage limits: 5-hour — 20% of the monthly limit; weekly — 50%; and monthly — 100%.

landingPageRequestEstimates.note: The Go landing page model table (header: Model | Relative request allowances | Est. requests / 5 hr | Monthly limit) publishes its own per-5-hour figures for Qwen4 Max, marked 'New'. These differ from the documentation's 5-hour figures and are kept side by side; neither is used to correct the other, and no average or reconciliation is computed.
landingPageRequestEstimates.rowAsPublished: Qwen4 Max (New) | Est. requests / 5 hr: Go: 463; Go Plus: 1,850 | Monthly limit: Go: $15; Go Plus: $60
landingPageRequestEstimates.discrepancyNote: Landing page 5-hour estimates (Go 463, Go Plus 1,850) versus documentation 5-hour estimates (Go 460, Go Plus 1,840). The landing page also has no Go Teams column, so no Teams figure is published there. The Monthly limit values agree on both surfaces ($15 Go, $60 Go Plus). Recorded as a parallel discrepancy; not resolved in this file.
landingPageRequestEstimates.relativeAllowancesNote: The landing page's 'Relative request allowances' column is rendered as a bar chart rather than a numeric cell, so it carries no transcribable number for this row.

requestShape.note: Published in the documentation request-shape list on 2026-11-17. The shape is identical to the adjacent Qwen3.8 Max row ('Qwen3.8 Max — 420 input, 66,000 cached, 200 output tokens per request').

privacy.apiCrossCheck: The models API go block for qwen4-max publishes training = false and zdr = true, which is consistent with the documentation 'Not used' / '0 days' row.

paidModel.landingPageBannerNote: The 'Hy4 is now available in Go' announcement banner present on the 2026-11-16 landing page is gone on 2026-11-17; the string does not occur in the 2026-11-17 landing page HTML, and the announcement layer that carried it on 2026-11-16 is absent from the 2026-11-17 page. There is no replacement Qwen4 banner; Qwen4 Max is instead marked 'New' inside the model table.
paidModel.modelCountNote: The landing-page counter reads 'View all 32 models' on 2026-11-17 (both the view-all button and the '32 models' count label), against 'View all 33 models' on 2026-11-16. This is the landing-page counter, a different series from the models API catalog count (31 → 32) below.

apiCatalogNote.note: The models API catalog holds 32 entries in total on 2026-11-17, including the new free model hy4-flash-free. This is the API catalog count and is a different series from the landing-page 'View all N models' counter (33 → 32), which counts the broader model list.
apiCatalogNote.createdTimestampNote: Every entry in the models API carries the same 'created' Unix timestamp (1794883146 on 2026-11-17; 1794796726 on 2026-11-16), which is the capture-time timestamp of the response, not a model creation date. Model dates are taken only from release_date and last_updated.
apiCatalogNote.goBlockAddedCatalogWide: On 2026-11-17 every catalog entry gained a 'go' block (monthly_usage / training / zdr / limited_regions) that no entry carried on 2026-11-16. For qwen4-max this block publishes monthly_usage {go: 15, go-plus: 60, go-teams: 20}, matching the documentation Monthly limit column exactly. Recorded as published; it does not change any adopted value.
apiCatalogNote.otherFieldChanges: Apart from the added 'go' block, the only qwen4-max field changes on 2026-11-17 are limit.output (393216 → 262144), the addition of capabilities.cache (implicit: true, explicit ttl ['5m', '1h']) and capabilities.reasoning.effort (['low', 'medium', 'xhigh'] → ['low', 'high', 'xhigh']). All other model entries are unchanged apart from the shared 'go' block.
